steps.en: Install the desktop app with one command
steps.zh: 一条命令装好桌面应用

steps.en: Open Deep Cleanup and start a scan
steps.zh: 打开“深度清理”，开始扫描

steps.en: Read-only scan of caches, dev tools and project build dirs via its built-in rules
steps.zh: 按内置规则只读扫描缓存、开发工具和项目构建目录

steps.en: Groups results by reclaimable space and pre-ticks only recommended items
steps.zh: 按可回收空间分组，只预勾选推荐项

steps.en: Review the list, adjust ticks, confirm the cleanup
steps.zh: 逐项查看、调整勾选，确认清理

steps.en: Re-checks each path, deletes permanently, logs it to Operation History
steps.zh: 逐条复核路径后永久删除，记入操作历史

value.en: You get the space back without guessing which cache or build folder is safe to delete — and can read why each one was eligible
value.zh: 不用再猜哪个缓存、哪个构建目录能删就把空间要回来，而且每一项为什么能删都有据可查
